data.narrative:
Atmo is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Alex Levy and Johan Mathe that has raised $29.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private frontier-tech peers and 1 public comparable (Palantir, PLTR), spanning companies at Series A and Series B stages. The private peer set includes Reflection AI ($25.0B), Together AI ($8.3B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression uses the $29.1M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement, implying $58M. Peer-median triangulation across the four AI & Software comparables yields a median valuation of $7.0B, with a range of $3.2B to $25.0B. The dispersion reflects material variation in stage and market position within the peer cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $49M to $8.0B, with a median of $3.5B. The wide spread reflects two distinct signals: stage-progression methodology implies a substantially lower valuation centered on near-term capital progression, while peer-median methodology suggests valuations in the multi-billion range consistent with frontier-AI positioning. Key uncertainties include Atmo's traction relative to peers, capital efficiency, and whether the peer set—dominated by generative AI and robotics companies—represents appropriate comparables for Atmo's specific application and go-to-market model.
